import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load_inline


# Define custom CUDA kernel for element-wise division (x / rms)
def _elementwise_div_kernel(const float* a, const float* b, float* out, int size):
    int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (idx < size) {
        out[idx] = a[idx] / b[idx];
    }


torch::Tensor elementwise_div_cuda(torch::Tensor a, torch::Tensor b) {
    auto size = a.numel();
    auto out = torch::zeros_like(a);

    const int block_size = 256;
    const int num_blocks = (size + block_size - 1) / block_size;

    elementwise_div_kernel<<<num_blocks, block_size>>>(a.data_ptr<float>(), b.data_ptr<float>(), out.data_ptr<float>(), size);

    return out;
}


elementwise_div_cpp_source = (
    "torch::Tensor elementwise_div_cuda(torch::Tensor a, torch::Tensor b);"
)

elementwise_div = load_inline(
    name="elementwise_div",
    cpp_sources=elementwise_div_cpp_source,
    cuda_sources=_elementwise_div_kernel + '''',
    functions=["elementwise_div_cuda"],
    verbose=True,
    extra_cflags=[],
    extra_ldflags=[],
)


# RMSNorm layer
class RMSNorm(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_features: int, eps: float = 1e-5):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_features = num_features
        self.eps = eps

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        # Calculate the RMS along the feature dimension (dim=1)
        rms = torch.sqrt(torch.mean(x ** 2, dim=1, keepdim=True) + self.eps)

        return x / rms


class ModelNew(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_features: int, eps: float = 1e-5):
        super().__init__()
        self.rmsnorm = RMSNorm(num_features, eps)

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        return self.rmsnorm(x)


# Compile the inline CUDA code for element-wise division
elementwise_div_cpp_source = (
    "torch::Tensor elementwise_div_cuda(torch::Tensor a, torch::Tensor b);"
)
elementwise_div = load_inline(
    name="elementwise_div",
    cpp_sources=elementwise_div_cpp_source,
    cuda_sources=_elementwise_div_kernel + '''',
    functions=["elementwise_div_cuda"],
    verbose=True,
    extra_cflags=[],
    extra_ldflags=[],
)
